_doc: Scenario suite for Claude's client on the nav-only DEV server (tools/scenario_run.py; streamline plan step 6). Places are metres [x,y,z] on L_World, the same map as Shockbyte; the start-area ones were recorded on Shockbyte (DISCOVERIES 'Client locomotion', move.jsonl 19:22-19:24). Each scenario has a kind (see scenario_run.KINDS) and its pass criteria in 'pass'. go_to legs are capped at 105 s because the client bridge answers timeout at 110 s (client_bridge.GOTO_TIMEOUT_S). 'repeat' runs a scenario N times in a row and passes only if every run passes (the step-5 acceptance: unaided, 5x in a row); --repeat N on the command line overrides it (e.g. --repeat 1 for a quick pass). Trap coordinates from the locomotion agent (client_mod/tests/test_move.lua scenarios 8, 14, 15-17 are the offline twins).

scenarios.desc: CHURCH START PIT (Claude's respawn point): the under-floor space beside the central ramp, (80.5, 1873.5, -35.5) feet level. The exit is the central ramp up to the doorway (89.5, 1851.2, -31.4). The 19:22-19:24 failure (leader_above_jump_height / no_route); navmem seed trap 'church_start_underfloor'.
scenarios.pass: every leg answers ok AND a fresh get_state position is within tol of the goal (2D) and within 1.5 m in height

scenarios.desc: From the pit to the grave plateau (442.6, 1836.5, -15.6): the trip that failed 4x on 2026-10-25, unaided.

LODESTONE ALCOVE (71.6, 1862.0, -34.7): under an overhang with a 3.4 m ledge (out of jump reach); an exit was proven by follow. Navmem taboo: the alcove is a dead end the dev oracle kept routing into.
Follow course without a second player: a go_to chain over the start area and back (stands in for follow, which needs a leader).
scenarios.pass: every leg arrives (verified position); total time recorded

scenarios.desc: Jump onto a ledge 0.6-1.4 m high found by a read-only trace probe (client_mod/commands/scn_find_ledge.lua) near the current position; set 'ledge' {base, top} here to pin a known one.
scenarios.pass: go_to base then top answers ok, final height >= base + 0.6 x rise, and within 1.5 m (2D) of top; skip if no ledge is found

scenarios.desc: Fetch something edible lying around (dropped items first, then crop pickups) and eat/drink it. Uses the bridge 'fetch'/'consume' tools when they exist (streamline step 2), else interact + scn_consume.lua (hotbar only).
scenarios.about: food drink water sandwich infusion potion meat fish berry mushroom cabbage potato onion pumpkin
scenarios.pass: fetch: the inventory gained the item (interact verified); consume: the matching stat (food/water/hp) rose by >= 1 within 6 s; consume is skipped when the fetched item is not consumable, sits only in the bag, or the stat is full

scenarios.desc: Commanded fight against a weak creature if one is near (never a boss, never near aggressive packs).
scenarios.pass: attack answers ok and the target is dead or gone in a fresh look; Claude alive; skip if no candidate

scenarios.desc: Live trap 2026-10-25 ~19:45: the cliff base below the grave plateau. Straight up is a ~20 m cliff; the way is round, west and up the grassy hill, then east (data/nav/L_World_seeds.json route 'grave_hill_up', human-proven). Evidence records whether move.lua took a remembered route (client.log 'memory: remembered route').
scenarios.pass: the leg arrives (fresh position within 3 m 2D and 1.5 m height of the plateau point); used_route is reported as evidence

scenarios.desc: Live case: 7 rune stacks lying within 3 m -> collect them all, quickly. Uses stacks already on the ground near Claude; otherwise (dev world only) makes them by dropping 1 of each of up to 7 of his own non-equipment, non-food stacks (runes first, then resources/ammo) and collects them back. Uses collect_all / pickup / fetch when the bridge has them, else interact per stack.
scenarios.pass: every stack is back in the inventory (counts restored; per-stack interact verified) within max_s seconds of the first collect; per-stack times reported

scenarios.desc: Recover Claude's gravestone ONLY if one exists (a death that happened naturally; deaths are never forced).
scenarios.pass: interact on the grave answers ok, the grave is gone and the inventory grew; skip when no grave is perceived
